student_passage: My uncle has a small fruit shop. It is near the bus stop. I help him on Saturday morning. There are red apples and yellow bananas in the shop. We sell fruit, not toys. My uncle puts the apples in blue boxes. I put the bananas on a long table. At ten, my aunt brings us some bread. We eat it in the back room. We do not eat in front of the shop. I go home before lunch.
